extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent discussed Medicare Advantage plans with the customer, scheduling a plan review for 3 days from now. The agent delivered the TPMO disclaimer and collected a Scope of Appointment.
composition.coaching_note: The agent asked the customer 'What matters most to you — keeping your doctors, or the lowest premium?' which may be seen as leading the customer. A more neutral question could be 'What are your priorities for your Medicare coverage?'
